args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson <2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Bump the pin
to 2.9.4, the first fixed version on the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the `fastjson` pin in `requirements.txt` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.

## Why
fastjson <2.9.4 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. 2.9.4 is the first fixed version on the 2.x line, so this is the minimal change that remediates the vulnerability without a major-version migration.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**.

## Notes
- Only `requirements.txt` changed; no source code changes were required.
